evidence_classes.independent_measurement: A non-author evaluator measured the result on the required real hardware.
evidence_classes.deterministic_execution: A non-author evaluator regenerated the result from the released executable workflow.
evidence_classes.public_physical_proxy: A public predictive-PDK or technology-normalization result, not the paper's commercial-foundry measurement.
evidence_classes.paper_comparison_target: A manuscript value used only for comparison and validation, never as generated evidence.

results.title: End-to-end speedup and S1-S4 latency breakdown
results.acceptance: Nine real Jetson Orin NX pairs; geometric-mean ASIC speedup within 5% of 2.94x; complete CUDA-event and stage records.

results.title: Energy efficiency and area-normalized throughput
results.acceptance: ASAP7 raw and DeepScale estimates are internally reproducible; commercial TSMC28 bars remain non-pass/fail targets.

results.title: Rendering quality
results.acceptance: All nine pairs; PSNR 0.15 dB, SSIM 0.005, and LPIPS 0.005 absolute tolerances.

results.title: Worst-case losses, latency, and RGB error maps
results.acceptance: Worst FSDR PSNR and SAES LPIPS views are selected from every executed target view without transformed plotting values.

results.title: FSDR and SAES ablation
results.acceptance: FSDR-only, SAES-only, and combined geometric means are within 5% relative error.

results.title: FSDR per-model statistics
results.acceptance: Discrete guided and full-search Top-1 counts, depth evaluations, and feature-buffer bytes satisfy fixed rate/count tolerances.

results.title: SAES per-model statistics
results.acceptance: L0/L1/Full, low-variance agreement, Gaussian savings, and S2 evaluation counts satisfy fixed rate/count tolerances.

results.title: Stage-wise MMCU active utilization
results.acceptance: Useful divided by scheduled MMCU slots is present for S1-S3 and within two percentage points of each paper bar.

results.title: FSDR cache-size sensitivity
results.acceptance: Five cache sizes, all nine pairs, a 32-entry throughput peak, and event-derived coverage/miss/overhead traces.

results.title: FSDR Hamming-threshold sensitivity
results.acceptance: Thresholds 1-5, all nine pairs, fixed throughput ratios, and monotonic quality degradation checks.

results.title: SAES feature/depth-threshold sensitivity
results.acceptance: Both five-point grids, all nine pairs, feature peak at 0.2, and depth saturation/quality-breakpoint checks.

results.title: SAES tile-size sensitivity
results.acceptance: Tile sizes 2-32, all nine pairs, and fixed throughput ratios relative to 4x4.

results.title: Area and power breakdown
results.command: bash scripts/run_ae.sh physical --output-root outputs/ae && bash scripts/run_ae.sh scale --output-root outputs/ae
results.acceptance: Hierarchical ASAP7 logic/SRAM-proxy rows and deterministic scaling are complete; TSMC28 rows are comparison-only.
